body: Found live 2026-08-09: 6 rapid emily observe calls collided on second-precision filenames, 5 of 6 observations silently lost. Fixed internal/obs/writer.go to detect collision and append numeric suffix instead of overwriting. Also wired currentSessionTag() into emily observe (payload.SessionTag + Apple RunID), matching apples post / changelog add. go test ./... green, build.sh smoke tests pass. Commit emily.cli 8ac855f + c3b14f9.
title: emily.cli: fix observe filename-collision data loss + wire session tag
